objective: Build a standard-library JSON-stdin/JSON-stdout uppercase CLI with real automated unittest coverage.
public_behavior_spec: The CLI should read JSON input from stdin.
The input JSON should contain a key 'text' with a string value.
The CLI should output JSON to stdout with the same key 'text' and the value converted to uppercase.

public_tests.description: Test that the CLI converts input text to uppercase.
Test that the CLI handles an empty string correctly.
Test that the CLI handles numeric input correctly.

qualitative_rubric: The CLI should handle typical edge cases such as empty strings and numeric input.
The CLI should produce valid JSON output for any valid JSON input.
The CLI should exit with status code 0 on successful execution.
stopping_condition: All public tests pass with 100% success rate.
